en-US.author: Huawei Technologies Co., Ltd.
en-US.description: Huawei's AI work assistant for daily office work, coding, and creative creation.
en-US.longDescription: Xiaoyi Work is Huawei's AI work assistant for daily office work, coding, and creative creation. Tell it your goal and it will break the task down, arrange the steps, call the right tools, and carry the work through, keeping progress visible while you review the key decisions. It collaborates across phones, tablets, and PCs so you can dispatch tasks remotely, follow progress, and accept results, offers both cloud and local execution environments, and can match suitable experts to your request.

zh-CN.author: 华为技术有限公司
zh-CN.description: 面向日常办公、代码开发和创意创作的 AI 工作助理。
zh-CN.longDescription: 小艺 Work 是华为推出的面向日常办公、代码开发和创意创作的 AI 工作助理。只需告诉小艺 Work 你的目标，它会自主拆解任务、安排步骤、调用合适的工具并推进执行，任务进度随时可见，关键节点由你审核把关。小艺 Work 支持手机、平板与电脑跨端协同，可远程下发任务、查看进度并验收成果；提供云电脑与本地电脑双执行环境，并可按需求自动匹配合适的专家协同工作。
zh-CN.name: 小艺Work
zh-CN.releaseNotes:
1. 体验优化：工作台支持多开页签，并记住每个任务的侧栏状态。
2. 体验优化：云空间支持分享、复制、重命名和批量删除。
3. 体验优化：定时任务支持一键执行和任务记录快速跳转。
